name: Frostsaber Provisions
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
If you wish to prove yourself, you may begin by doing a very simple, but very important task.

Gather meat from the chimaera and from the shardtooth bears in the area. Bring it to me so that I may use it to feed the frostsabers that are being trained.
narrative.objectives: Collect 5 Shardtooth Meats and 5 Chillwind Meats for Rivern Frostwind in Winterspring.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you for assisting me, adventurer. My opinion of you grows as time passes.
narrative.requestItemsText: Discipline and determination are your goals. I may ask you to do a simple task many times; you must perform to the best of your ability each time.
